iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS
       An iRule event that triggers when an MQTT message is received from server-side.

DESCRIPTION
       This iRule event triggers when an MQTT message is received from server-side.  In case an MQTT message has large payload
       such as for server PUBLISH message types, this event may trigger before entire payload is received. In that case,
       MQTT::collect may be used to obtain the payload.

Examples
	when MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS {
	   set type [MQTT::type]
	   switch $type {
	      "CONNACK" {
		  log local0.info "New connection ack [MQTT::return_code]"
	      }
	   }
	}

HINTS
